- Estimated gross monthly savings vs on-demand: $6.5k — $9k depending on model mix

2) Aggressive: +40% committed capacity, 25% term discount, include SLA addendum (priority queue, 99.95% uptime) — requires sign-off from finance/legal.

Operational notes: prefix caching and KV reuse on your inference patterns should reduce burst token cost by ~12% once we enable the recommended cache policy. I called out those expected gains in the attached spreadsheet.

Next steps I propose: 30-minute call this week to confirm target option and finalize language for the SLA addendum. If you prefer, I can loop in Steph (finance) and Marissa (CS) before the call.
